briefdescription.para: Writes the declarations at the position of a request, each with its scope.

detaileddescription.para: The scope is the path of the declaration without its last segment. Each JSON element holds the scope as an array of names.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file and the position.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the symbols of the file in a request, as a tree.

detaileddescription.para: The request must hold one argument, the file. Each symbol holds its named declarations as children. Unnamed declarations give their children to their parent.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its single argument is the file.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the counterpart files of the file in a request, each as an object that holds only its path.

detaileddescription.para: A request that holds other than one argument writes an empty array, and sets the overlay message.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its single argument is the file.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes each call reference of the file in a request, with the parameter texts of its first function declaration.

detaileddescription.para: The entries are in result order: path, then position. A call with no function declaration gets an empty parameters array. A request that holds other than one argument writes an empty array, and sets the overlay message.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its single argument is the file.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the declarations whose last name matches the fuzzy query of a request.

detaileddescription.para: The request must hold one argument, the query. Other argument counts set the overlay message.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its single argument is the query.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the completions of the name that ends before the position of a request, as a JSON array.

detaileddescription.para: The position is the cursor after the typed name, so the lookup reads the byte before it. No stored document, no element, or an element of another type gives an empty array. The lookup reads the stored documents and starts no parse.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file, the line, and the column.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the implementations of the declarations at the position of a request.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file and the position.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the function declarations at the position of a request, as the start of a call hierarchy.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file and the position.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the parents of the call elements that refer to the function at the position of a request.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file and the position.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Writes the declarations that the calls inside the function at the position of a request refer to.

detaileddescription.para: The walk visits each element under the function declaration. Each call element gives the declarations with its symbol.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its arguments give the file and the position.
The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Returns the index in paths of the file that a request names.

detaileddescription.para: The file argument resolves against the folder of the client. The request stores that folder in its directory, because this process can run in a different folder.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its directory and its file argument give the path.

simplesect.para: The index of the path in paths, or -1 when the path is not stored.

parameterdescription.para: The index that holds the documents and the symbol maps.

briefdescription.para: Returns the file that a request names, resolved against the folder that the request stores.

detaileddescription.para: This process can run in a different folder from the client, so the request holds the folder of the client in its directory.

parameterdescription.para: The request row. Its directory and its file argument give the file.

simplesect.para: The file named by the file argument, under the directory of the request.
